note: Holiday-shortened week: Fri Jul 3 Independence Day market holiday (Jul 2 early close 1pm); June payrolls move to Thu Jul 2. Broad late-June drawdown left few names at 52w highs, so the book is intentionally more defensive: 10 positions, ~86% deployed.

positions.name: Eli Lilly
positions.catalyst: Surged +9.5% Fri 6/26 to a fresh ATH ($1,202.86) after a positive EMA (CHMP) opinion recommending broader Jaypirca authorization across all lines of CLL therapy; GLP-1 momentum (oral orforglipron) intact.
positions.risks: High absolute level; single-name event risk; GLP-1 pricing/competition headlines.
positions.driver: Mega-cap healthcare breaking to new highs on a fresh regulatory catalyst.

positions.name: Cencora
positions.catalyst: Strong Buy daily technical with a ~5.5% weekly rebound; specialty/pharma distribution momentum; Buy consensus, avg PT ~$351; defensive ballast.
positions.risks: Off its 52w high (YTD -15.6%); GLP-1 distribution-margin dynamics; below-trend longer-term momentum.
positions.driver: Defensive healthcare distributor rebounding with a constructive technical setup.

positions.name: GE Aerospace
positions.catalyst: Fresh all-time highs into the week; held up best among industrials on the 6/26 selloff (-0.6%); Strong Buy; aftermarket/engine demand; relative-strength leader.
positions.risks: Rich valuation at highs; cyclical aero; payrolls 7/2.
positions.driver: Best-in-class aero-engine franchise showing clear relative strength at new highs.

positions.name: Eaton
positions.catalyst: Set a fresh ATH ($436.74) on 6/22 and held within ~4% into 6/26; AI-datacenter electrification leader; hyperscaler power-buildout backlog.
positions.driver: AI-power/electrification leader consolidating just below new highs.

positions.name: GE Vernova
positions.catalyst: +117% over the past year; Strong Buy, PT ~$1,220; gas-turbine demand from hyperscaler data-center power (key AI bottleneck).
positions.risks: ~13% off its high; high absolute level; AI-capex sentiment; payrolls 7/2.
positions.driver: Pure-play on AI electricity demand with the strongest 1-yr momentum in the book.

positions.name: JPMorgan Chase
positions.catalyst: Held near all-time highs (+1.2% on the week) while GS/MS sold off; resilient NII/capital returns; analysts favor large-cap financials; quarter-end positioning.
positions.risks: Rate-sensitive into payrolls 7/2; credit-cycle; broad-financial beta.
positions.driver: Highest-quality money-center bank showing relative strength near highs.

positions.name: Visa

positions.risks: Not at highs; consumer-spend sensitivity; litigation/regulatory headlines.
positions.driver: Defensive payments compounder showing relative strength in a risk-off tape.

positions.name: Interactive Brokers
positions.catalyst: Touched a fresh 52w high ($97.84) on 6/22; Buy consensus; broker benefits from elevated volatility and rates; account-growth momentum.
positions.risks: ~8% off the high; avg PT near current price (limited consensus upside); rate-path sensitivity.
positions.driver: High-momentum broker near 52w highs; volatility beneficiary into a binary-data week.

positions.name: Micron Technology
positions.catalyst: FQ3 blowout (rev $41.5B; Q4 guide ~$50B) on AI/HBM demand; held ~flat through the 6/26 semi selloff while NVDA/AVGO fell hard; PT hikes (TD Cowen $1,500).
positions.risks: Only semi in the book; chip-complex beta; pulled back from the $1,255 post-earnings ATH; payrolls 7/2.
positions.driver: Most resilient large-cap semi post-earnings, anchored by a record AI-memory outlook.

positions.name: Philip Morris International
positions.catalyst: +19.5% over 30 days near its ATH; smoke-free momentum (IQOS/ZYN) with favorable FDA guidance; classic defensive momentum leader.
positions.risks: ~5% below the high; FX translation; regulatory/litigation; defensive crowding.
positions.driver: Defensive staple with genuine momentum at highs — ballast plus participation.
